manifest.canon: Chapter16 Chao Gai is one of seven shirtless merchants who cover tribute goods in seven Jiangzhou carts and push away. Brown cloth/beard/trousers/sandals, single wheel, material colours and weapon stowage are existing art interpretations. Current three targets/force branch, other carriers, words, seven-cart/eleven-load mapping and full wheel rotation remain open. Only chao_gai/hn_chao_gai carrying_tribute in level1.
